model_annotation: The horizontal bar chart illustrates numerical values associated with seven different, partially obscured categories. The vertical axis lists the categories, although their labels are significantly blurred or truncated on the left side of the image, displaying visible text fragments from top to bottom such as "...t FCS", "...mmary", "...nce Explanation", "...and Simplicity", "... Summary", a largely obscured label, and "...y Explanation". The horizontal value axis uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 6, with tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 2, but it lacks an explicit axis title or unit of measurement. The chart displays seven unstacked horizontal bars sorted in descending order of length, with each bar sequentially following a color gradient from dark to light. Notably, every bar is annotated with its exact whole-number value just past its right edge. The tallest bar at the top is dark purple and represents a maximum value of 6 for the "...t FCS" category. Continuing downward, the bars are colored dark grayish-blue (value 5), dark teal (value 3), medium teal (value 3), and medium green (value 2). The chart concludes with the two shortest bars at the bottom, which are colored light green and yellow-green respectively, both representing the minimum depicted value of 1.
